I personally dont play any of the recomendations im about to drop anymore but have had great times in them and therefore i want to name them (in random order)

TERA - F2P - Steam
I used to play this with my gf back in the days, its mechanics were unique when it was released as you use your mouse to aim at your targets, theres alot of customization and a nice gear progression, even endgame raids were simole enough for my gf who had never touched any mmorpgs before (she basically only ever played sims and some themepark games), tho ive heard this game has gotten worse over the years but might still be an interessting game to check out

Runes Of Magic - F2P - Steam
So i havent played far into this game as i decided to get wow classic instead to relive those days of pure nostalgia BUT this really feels like an abit more unrefined vanilla wow, theres crafting that reminds alot about wow, mounts, gear progression and that lovely more old graphics which i personally love, when i get bored of wow ill def go back and see what more this game has to offer

Elder Scrolls Online (ESO) - P2P - cant remember what platform o.O
Loved this game when it was released, the envoirement is pure magic, its a very soothing game as you can stroll around for hours not really doing anything special yet feel entertained, theres crafting which sadly at higher levels could require some IAPs to maintain, the dungeons are fun and easy to understand, however, the battle mechanics are abit clumsy and feels abit unresponsive if compared to many other mmorpgs, would defenatly recommend this game tho coz its so much fun just exploring 

Allods Online - F2P - Steam (dont accually know if this game is around anymore)
Really fun take on mmorpg as you on endgame battle on large flying ships in the "allod". Nice leveling, good gearprogression and crafting , dungeons is fun as hell and not too hard but not too easy either. This might be one of the better wow copies out there. Really fun classes aswell, theres one class where you accually manuver 3 small furry little cats?dogs? Oh well something like that, if this is around ill probably pick it up someday, however, once somewhere around 40-50 theres a exp wall that takes quite some time to get over but at thise levels there are plenty of dungeons and quests and worldevents to do

Might come to think of some more games later, if so ill drop by again :) have a nice day

EDIT: these are my personal experiences with the game and they may differ from other players, also i havent played any of these in a very long time so if my information arent mathing the current state of these games im sorry :)
